title: JEPA-DNA: Grounding Genomic Foundation Models through Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2602.17162v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) typically rely on Masked Language Modeling (MLM) or Next-Token Prediction (NTP) to learn the "Laws of Nature". While effective at capturing local syntax, these generative paradigms prioritize token-level reconstruction over high-level functional context. We introduce JEPA-DNA, a model-agnostic continual training framework that integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) with traditional generative objectives. By supervising global sequence embeddings in a latent space, JEPA-DNA forces models to predict the functional representations of masked genomic segments, shifting the learning signal from token recovery to semantic alignment. translated_title: JEPA-DNA：通过联合嵌入预测架构为基因组基础模型奠定功能基础
translated_abstract: 基因组基础模型（GFMs）通常依赖掩码语言建模（MLM）或下一词元预测（NTP）来学习“自然法则”。尽管这些生成式范式在捕捉局部语法方面行之有效，但它们优先考虑词元级重建而非高层功能上下文。我们提出JEPA-DNA，这是一个与具体模型无关的持续训练框架，它将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与传统的生成式目标相结合。通过在潜在空间中对全局序列嵌入进行监督，JEPA-DNA迫使模型预测被掩码基因组片段的功能表示，从而将学习信号从词元恢复转向语义对齐。我们在17个多样化的基因组基准任务上评估了JEPA-DNA，结果显示无论底层GFM架构或生成式目标如何，线性探测和零样本性能均获得一致提升，并为基因组基础模型确立了新的最先进水平。
tldr: JEPA-DNA将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与传统生成式训练目标相结合，使基因组基础模型从词元级重建转向功能语义对齐，在17个基准任务上均取得一致提升并创下新的最先进水平。
en_tdlr: JEPA-DNA integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with generative training objectives, shifting genomic foundation models from token-level reconstruction to functional semantic alignment, achieving consistent gains across 17 benchmarks and setting a new state-of-the-art.
